meta.brand_style_block: Warm natural lighting, Pacific Northwest environment, earth tone palette with deep forest green (#2D4A3E) anchoring trust and terracotta copper (#C17B5D) for warmth and CTAs, cream/linen surfaces (#FAF7F2), editorial photography feel with 50mm equivalent lens and shallow depth of field, slightly desaturated warm color grade, approachable and refined atmosphere, residential and lifestyle subjects, no harsh shadows, no clinical sterile feel, Cormorant Garamond serif headings convey editorial sophistication, DM Sans body conveys modern clarity.
meta.negative_prompt_block: generic stock photo feel, cheesy staged smiles, over-saturated colors, HDR look, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, unreadable text in image, watermarks, logos, heavy vignette, fisheye distortion, AI artifacts, uncanny valley faces, corporate sterile environment, fake property addresses, identifiable house numbers, real estate listing watermarks, MLS overlays, luxury mansion unless specified, dark moody horror lighting.

assets.alt_text: Kristina Bullock, Portland Oregon real estate broker
assets.notes: Client-supplied headshot. High-res (2047x2048), warm natural lighting, soft green background. Matches brand profile perfectly. Display in 3:4 contained portrait card, object-position: top center.
Subtle cream linen texture. Should be barely perceptible — adds warmth vs flat #FAF7F2. If too visible, reduce opacity in CSS to 30-50%.
Lucide React icons (Home, DollarSign, TrendingUp) at 40x40px, 1.5px stroke, #C17B5D. Implemented in code — no generation needed.
Reuse of client headshot in 1:1 square crop at 260-320px. Face centers well in square format.

assets.alt_text: Portland Oregon skyline with Mt. Hood and Hawthorne Bridge at golden hour
assets.notes: AI-generated Portland skyline. Check that Mt. Hood shape is recognizable (not a generic mountain). Bridge should resemble Hawthorne or similar Portland bridge. Warm golden hour lighting matches brand. No identifiable addresses — industry_safeguards.real_estate compliant.

assets.alt_text: Tree-lined suburban street with family homes in Beaverton Oregon
assets.notes: PNW suburban residential street. Mature trees, well-maintained homes, family-friendly feel. Generic architecture — not a specific property. Compliant with real_estate safeguards: no fake addresses, no identifiable listings.

assets.alt_text: Lakeside view with waterfront homes in Lake Oswego Oregon
assets.notes: Serene lakeside with PNW vegetation and upscale homes at distance. Slightly premium feel matching Lake Oswego positioning. No specific property identifiable.

assets.alt_text: Walking path through suburban park in Tigard Oregon
assets.notes: Park scene with walking path. If distant people are visible, verify they appear natural and anonymous (backs/silhouettes only — global safeguard). PNW vegetation appropriate.

assets.alt_text: Modern residential homes in Gresham Oregon neighborhood
assets.notes: Newer residential development. Should look affordable/mid-market — NOT luxury. Gresham is positioned as the affordable entry point. If AI generated McMansions, regenerate with adjusted prompt emphasizing modest ranch/two-story homes.

assets.alt_text: Modern downtown streetscape in Hillsboro Oregon
assets.notes: Modern mixed-use streetscape. Check for AI-generated text on storefronts — if legible brand names appear, regenerate. Global safeguard: no logos or product marks the client doesn't own.
Dark forest green (#2D4A3E) linen texture. Must maintain high contrast with white/cream text overlay. If texture is too prominent, apply at 20-40% opacity in CSS.

assets.alt_text: Line chart showing Portland Oregon median home value trend with stabilizing growth pattern
assets.notes: Build as Recharts LineChart. Structural labels only — NO specific dollar amounts. Global safeguard: no fake statistics or fabricated charts. Uses schematic/placeholder values showing general trend shape.

assets.alt_text: Horizontal bar chart comparing rental demand in Portland Metro, Oregon, and nationally
assets.notes: Build as Recharts BarChart. Relative bar lengths only — NO specific percentages. Visual comparison showing Portland leading. Compliant with global safeguard on fabricated data.

assets.alt_text: Five-step timeline of the senior home transition process from consultation through closing
assets.notes: Build as custom React component with Lucide icons. Process steps are real service descriptions from Kristina's differentiators — not fabricated. Terracotta step markers, forest green connector line.

assets.alt_text: Craftsman-style Portland home exterior with warm porch light at dusk
assets.notes: PNW Craftsman home at dusk. Warm inviting feel. Generic architecture — no identifiable address. Perfect for the buying page hero. real_estate safeguard: not mistakable for a specific listing.

assets.alt_text: Bright staged living room with natural light and modern warm decor
assets.notes: Staged interior, natural light, PNW greenery outside. Check that staging is neutral/mid-market (not luxury or budget). Should look like a well-prepared listing, not a magazine spread. No personal items or identifiable elements.

assets.alt_text: Well-maintained duplex investment property in Portland Oregon
assets.notes: PNW duplex or small multi-family. Should look practical/investor-minded, not luxury. Verify AI generated a plausible duplex layout (separate entrances, two-story). No identifiable address. real_estate safeguard compliant.
